Name: Yearly Stardrop
Author: AbiRabb1t
Description:
This mod will send you a stardrop in a letter every time it is new year from your good friend and store owner peirre. Where he gets them from is a question that is better off not asked.

Simply this mod send all players a Star Drop Once a year. This is meant to be used along side mods like nightowl. This is a simple mod.

Manifest.Name: (MFM) Yearly Stardrop
Manifest.Description: Sends you a letter with a Star Drop on new years eve every year
Manifest.Author: RUNETHERABB1T
